item.title: Drip Irrigation for Fabric Grow Bags on Patios and Balconies
item.description: Disclosure: This guide contains affiliate links. We earn a commission if you purchase through these links — at no extra cost to you. See affiliate disclosure for details. Fabric grow bags are popular for balcony vegetables because they breathe, drain well, and fold flat in winter. But they also dry faster than plastic pots, especially on hot patios and windy balconies. A standard drip setup built for rigid containers often fails on grow bags because water channels down one side, edges dry while the center stays wet, or the bag’s flex shifts emitters away from the root zone.
